quant.name: W8A8_DYNAMIC
notes: Declared representation template; retained tensor samples establish selected contracts separately.

force_eplb.basis: new launch additional_config; actual routed count values not exported

metadata.geometry_policy: physical array extent is not proof of active requests; derive every target geometry from complete topology and retain output rows separately

hybrid_cache_allocation.basis: new resolved allocator log plus native K/V axis128 in both complete probes

native_source_mechanisms.ffn_tp_reduction: ordinary dense TP reduction from model
native_source_mechanisms.gdn_recurrent: A3 analytical recurrent path retained; no unsupported arch35 kernel copied
native_source_mechanisms.fia: native seven-slot GQA descriptors; source-oracle branch selection retained, no error-driven kernel choice
native_source_mechanisms.page_domain: runtime.kv_block_size128 is native K/V axis; allocator LCM640/896 retained separately

native_representation_correction.basis: retained complete low/high concurrency Body tensor ABI only; no timing or prediction used
native_representation_correction.native_scale_storage_vs_contract: Matrix active-geometry contract does not compare weight scale storage representation; this correction does not promote to full native ABI.

gqa_decode_source_mapping.basis: explicit FAI source-host ownership with analytical staged GQA device execution
gqa_decode_source_mapping.native_evidence_scope: two bounded complete target bodies from this deployment; full geometry populations retained separately
gqa_decode_source_mapping.mapping_policy: fai_host explicitly selects the source flash-decode or regular query/head ownership branch; target_cores is the declared launch-grid budget
unobserved_dispatch_fields: native query/key tiles and pipeline slots
gqa_decode_source_mapping.context_policy: Use each source declared context condition and measured B/q; page/table capacity is not an actual sequence length
